headline: Peacock raises prices across all subscription tiers by up to $3
summary: The streaming service Peacock has increased the cost of its subscription plans, with some tiers seeing a $3 jump.
details: Peacock has officially announced price increases for all of its subscription tiers. This move follows a trend of rising costs among streaming services.

The Premium tier, which offers more content and an ad-free experience, will now cost $5.99 per month, up from $4.99. The Premium Plus tier, which removes all ads, has been bumped up to $9.99 per month from $9.99.

The ad-supported tier has also seen a price hike, now costing $5.99 per month, an increase from the previous $4.99. These new prices are effective immediately for new subscribers and will apply to existing subscribers at their next billing cycle.

This price adjustment comes as Peacock continues to expand its content library, including exclusive live sports and original series. The company aims to balance content investment with subscriber value.
